shortDescription: According to Bloomberg, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has suggested potential candidates for the country’s next US ambassador. The post has been vacant since August.

title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy Suggests Potential Candidates for US Ambassador Post
